card.name: Ends of stock warning sentences
card.fires_on: The period closing the C. difficile toxin sentence (after CDI or CDAD), and the word "not" in "whether or not they are taking antidepressant medications". Both sit in fixed warning text in drug labels.

modes.label: C. difficile sentence end
modes.description: The period after CDI or CDAD, ending the sentence on toxins A and B, just before the hypertoxin-producing strains sentence.

modes.label: Whether or not
modes.description: The word "not" in "whether or not they are taking antidepressant medications" in the suicidality warning.
modes.example: unusual changes in behavior, whether or<< not>> they are taking antidepressant medications, and

card.plain: It lights up at set points in two standard label warnings: the end of the C. difficile toxin sentence and the "whether or not" in the antidepressant warning.
